Hi Laura,

Your new YA dystopian thriller Nourish, published by Habitat Press in July 2026 and following Cal in a post-food world, sounds gripping, and I also noticed that Dirt won Best Book for Teenagers at the Wishing Shelf Book Awards.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author. Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

If a short trailer or a few promotional reels for Nourish is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production, from concept to finished video. It would be an optional add-on that sits alongside the feature and gives readers another way to meet Cal's world, and we would shape it around your vision for the book.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Nourish best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
